snippet.title: Robots At Midnight Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
#ActionAdventure #RPG #Adventure #Robots #SciFi #RobotsAtMidnight 

Cryo-sleep is over.
Awaken as Zoe, a young hero thrust into the perilous wasteland of Yob- a planet that was once a thriving luxury destination, now reduced to ruins crawling with corrupted machines and buried secrets. With only her MITT gauntlet and a floating admin droid named Phlite, Zoe must fight to survive, uncover the truth behind The Blackout, and find her missing father.
Robots at Midnight is a retro-futuristic action-adventure that blends momentum-driven combat, atmospheric exploration, and rich world-building.
Survive, adapt, and get home before midnight.

Buy Robots at Midnight Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2623040/Robots_at_Midnight/

Buy Robots at Midnight Now on Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9nc17sx06dcn 

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/smGVU9SQg2
